# Suggested GitHub repository About profile

This file is the reviewable source of truth for the public GitHub **About** settings. GitHub's About metadata is configured in the repository UI, not automatically inherited from this Markdown file.

**Repository:** https://github.com/mitchelldawkinsjr/launch-and-own

## Description

> No-code website launch beta: describe, preview and approve customer-owned sites on GitHub + Cloudflare. Describe it. Launch it. Own it.

## Website

https://onboard.360web.cloud

## Topics

`website-builder`, `no-code`, `cloudflare-workers`, `cloudflare-pages`, `github-app`, `oauth`, `website-deployment`, `static-sites`, `customer-owned`, `onboarding`

## How to apply the metadata

1. Open the repository and choose the **gear icon** next to **About**.
2. Paste the description above into **Description**.
3. Paste the website URL into **Website**.
4. Add the listed topics (GitHub accepts up to 20), and save.

These fields are currently blank. The linked GitHub integration cannot change repository-level About settings, so a user with repository administration privileges must do this one-time step. Do not label this project as `open-source` or claim the site-launch flow is production-verified until the project license and independent QA evidence support those claims.

## Positioning notes

**Brand:** Launch & Own

**Promise:** Describe it. Launch it. Own it.

**Audience:** small businesses, solo operators, nonprofits and everyday people who want a simple website without hiring a developer or learning a hosting stack.

**How it works:** Sign in with your own GitHub and Cloudflare, write or edit a one-page site, preview the exact result, then explicitly approve creation of a private repository and Cloudflare Pages site. Site maintenance should remain owner-controlled through reviewed GitHub pull requests.

**Status:** hosted OAuth/account selection and local preview are available; first independent customer repository/Pages deployment is under QA [Issue #21](https://github.com/mitchelldawkinsjr/launch-and-own/issues/21). Browser maintenance UI is a separate draft [PR #31](https://github.com/mitchelldawkinsjr/launch-and-own/pull/31). No public ChatGPT plugin or guaranteed free-forever hosting. Keep public copy factual as release status changes.

**Suggested social-preview title:** Launch & Own — Describe it. Launch it. Own it.

**Suggested social-preview subtitle:** Build a website on accounts you own, with a clear preview and explicit approval. Browser beta.

**Potential social-preview artwork:** original product-branded 1280×640 static image, no private account details or claim of independently verified launch. GitHub's social-preview upload requires an admin in repository Settings; do not change provider OAuth logos/screens while preparing a repo banner.
